questions.question: At which ground did Iinyathi record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — highest total of 162, against Heat on 2015/10/18.

questions.question: At which ground did Selaelo Mphahele record their career-best innings (26, T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval, against Limpopo Lillies on 2013/10/06.

questions.question: Who has achieved the fifty and 5 wickets in a match double more times, Jessica Candler or Dané van Niekerk?
questions.explanation: Jessica Candler: 1 times. Dané van Niekerk: 2 times.

questions.question: At Buffalo Park, who holds the record for 'Most Runs' (T20)?
Excluding Western Province, which team has won the most domestic titles in this database?
questions.explanation: Dragons have won 4 titles, the most of any union other than the dominant Western Province.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most Maidens' in the 12/13 season (T20)?
questions.explanation: Raisibe Ntozakhe holds it, with a total of 6.
